headword: {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}
gloss: basic fee; base charge; basic rate

definitions.gloss: basic fee; base charge; basic rate
definitions.explanation: A fixed fee charged as the minimum or starting amount for a service, before any additional usage charges are added.

examples.japanese: ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the basic fare for a taxi?

examples.japanese: ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The basic charge for my mobile phone went up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使用量|しようりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{一定額|いっていがく}→一定額：27382_itteigaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The basic electricity charge is a fixed amount every month regardless of usage.

notes:
A practical compound frequently encountered in daily life in Japan, especially when dealing with utilities, taxis, phone plans, and other services. Composed of ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧ (basic, fundamental) and ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (fee, charge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: the basic fee is included
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: no basic fee
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}+⟦{従量制|じゅうりょうせい}→従量制：26340_juuryousei⟧: basic fee plus usage-based pricing
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧: review of the basic rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初乗|はつの}り⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: initial fare (taxis) — the starting fare for the first distance
- ⟦{定額|ていがく}→定額：09740_teigaku⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: flat-rate fee — a fixed fee regardless of usage
- ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: handling fee / commission — a fee for processing or service

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, utility bills (⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧・⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧・⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧) and mobile phone plans commonly have a {基本料金|きほんりょうきん} component. Recent deregulation of the electricity market has led to more competition on basic rates.
